origin.origins.fishman.name: Fishman
origin.origins.fishman.description: Children of the deep who carry a little of the sea inside them. Wet, they are tireless and fierce, and the tide bends to their will; dry, they parch, and the surface world has no kindness for them.
power.origins.conduit_power_on_land.name: Conduit Power
power.origins.conduit_power_on_land.desc: While wet, submerged or under open rain, you carry the strength of a conduit with you.
